achievements.title: Best Use of RocketRide
achievements.heroCaption: Accepting the Best Use of RocketRide award at Frontier Tower
achievements.oneliner: 1st in the RocketRide track for Runbook, an AI incident-response agent.
achievements.summary: Won 1st Place in the RocketRide track (Best Use of RocketRide) at the Memory Meets Motion Hackathon at Frontier Tower in San Francisco on August 3, where developers spent the day shipping agentic workflows and stateful AI.
bullets: Built Runbook, an AI-powered incident response platform that connects communication, project management, and development tools into one workflow.
When a customer reports an issue in Slack, Runbook investigates it using company knowledge and previous incidents, identifies what went wrong, and recommends a fix.
It creates a Linear ticket, prepares a draft GitHub pull request, and sends an update back to the customer, with RocketRide running the diagnosis and a human approving the fix.
